nodes.name: Feed
nodes.text: Bars arrive from the engine’s configured data feed. This site receives exported observations; it does not fetch prices or run a live feed.

nodes.name: Structure
nodes.text: The engine records swings, breaks and liquidity levels from closed bars. The site only displays the structure included in an export.

nodes.name: Context
nodes.text: A session has a recorded bias, trend and reference levels. Context is exported with the session so a replay can show what was known.

nodes.name: Intraday
nodes.text: The engine limits when candidates can arm. Exported windows describe those times; the browser does not decide whether a trade is allowed.

nodes.name: Models
nodes.text: A candidate belongs to a model. The NQ engine studies reversal and continuation; MNQ strategy descriptions and evidence are separate.

nodes.name: Score
nodes.text: The engine exports a candidate’s score. The dial is a display of that value, with a threshold only when one is exported.

nodes.name: Gates
nodes.text: Named checks record pass or fail. A replay shows their saved verdicts; none of those checks are evaluated on this site.

nodes.name: Tracker
nodes.text: A recorded alert can be followed as a virtual trade from entry to exit. Stops, targets, costs and losses remain part of the exported record.

nodes.name: Alerts
nodes.text: Alerts inform a person. This site does not submit orders or connect to an execution account.

nodes.name: Ledger and storage
nodes.text: Closed trades and session decisions are saved by c3.lab. Signed bundles give the site a versioned, one-way view of that record.

nodes.name: Lab
nodes.text: Ideas are judged in a search window and then a locked holdout. Rejections and failed holdouts remain visible alongside candidates.

nodes.name: Site
nodes.text: The Worker verifies the bundle and publishes a final pointer. Public pages read exported JSON and label its source, costs and sample.
